name: Control-Plane Repository Interface
description: Define a clean repository interface that abstracts the storage backend. SQLite and PGlite implementations both satisfy it.
purpose: Callers don't know or care which backend is active.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository interface is defined as a TypeScript interface or abstract class
Interface covers all CRUD operations for campaigns, missions, lanes, tasks, receipts, checkpoints, memory links
SQLiteRepository implements the interface and tests pass
PGliteRepository implements the interface and tests pass
DualReadRepository wraps both and implements verification logic
Callers reference only the interface, never concretions
